title: 2024 Bowman Chrome George Wolkow 1st Bowman Chrome #BCP-144 White Sox
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2024 Bowman Chrome trading card features George Wolkow, a player for the Major League Baseball team Chicago Whitesox. The card measures 3½" x 2½" and is an original, not a licensed reprint. It is a 1st Edition card from the 2024 set, with a Card Number of BCP-144. 

The card is in a Chrome parallel/variety and is not autographed. It is perfect for collectors of baseball memorabilia and fans of the Chicago Whitesox. Get your hands on this rare and valuable card today!
